item.title: Community Price Check: The Compound Ski & Snowboard Shop talks tariffs, price shifts
item.description: The Compound orders its gear from manufactures all over the world, and just under a year into a tariff-based shift in international imports, store owner Brandon Croney says as the industry continues to climb in pricing, its customers still deserve a chance at the right quality.

item.title: Mather Inn to host award winning blues guitarist D.K. Harrell
item.description: On Friday, March 13, award winning guitarist and vocalist D.K. Harrell and his band will perform a night at the Mather Inn. The 27-year-old star will play from his new album 'Talkin' Heavy,' nominated for best album of the year, along with his nomination for Best Contemporary Blues Artist in the 2026 Blues Awards.

item.title: President Trump Set to Deliver State of the Union Address with Focus on Economy
item.description: The prime-time speech to the country will come amid major tensions at home and abroad. The annual address is a constitutional obligation — but it's also a political opportunity for presidents to tout accomplishments, priorities and policies.

item.title: Congressional Members Weigh in on Four Years of Russia’s War on Ukraine
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - Tuesday marks four years since Russia invaded Ukraine. The invasion has tested Ukrainians and their partners, pushing back on Russian President Vladimir Putin’s quest to conquer Ukraine.

item.title: Michigan Democrats, labor unions push bill to limit AI workplace surveillance
item.description: Michigan Democrats and labor leaders are backing legislation to regulate how employers use artificial intelligence to monitor workers. Supporters say the technology is already being used to track employees’ movements, productivity and even bathroom breaks.
